headline: AGI Greenpac appoints Shaili Tyagi as Chief Human Resources Officer
summary: AGI Greenpac Limited has announced the appointment of Ms Shaili Tyagi as its new Chief Human Resources Officer, effective October 12, 2026. This is a routine senior management change at the listed packaging company. Indian retail investors generally see little direct stock impact from standard HR leadership appointments.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact on retail holdings
